avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces nifedipine levels and efficacy
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; may require nifedipine dose adjustment if discontinued

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit Seed Extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases nifedipine bioavailability and hypotensive effects
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; separate administration timing does not prevent interaction

caution_supplements.name: Goldenseal
caution_supplements.mechanism: May inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing nifedipine levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure; report dizziness or edema to clinician

caution_supplements.name: Licorice
caution_supplements.mechanism: Sodium retention and potassium loss may counteract antihypertensive effects
caution_supplements.action: Monitor blood pressure regularly; use minimal amounts

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit Juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition dramatically increases nifedipine concentration (up to 4-fold), causing severe hypotension
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit and grapefruit juice; effects persist for 24+ hours

caution_foods.name: High-Fat Meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase nifedipine absorption and bioavailability, potentially enhancing hypotensive effects
caution_foods.action: Maintain consistent meal timing and fat intake; take consistently with or without food

caution_foods.name: Caffeinated Beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: Caffeine may counteract hypotensive effects and increase heart rate variability
caution_foods.action: Moderate caffeine intake; monitor blood pressure and heart rate response

monitoring_notes: Monitor blood pressure regularly and assess for peripheral edema, headache, and dizziness. Counsel patients to maintain consistent dietary habits and strictly avoid grapefruit products due to critical interaction risk.
